  PROBLEM: The capacity-wait branch calls write_standalone_state_json (15719-15747, failures suppressed with `|| true` at 15742/15745) and then continues without confirming the updated state was persisted.
  WHY: If the write fails, the stored comment keeps the old last_seen_phase and status_since_ts, so after the wait label is removed the stall window may not restart and recovery can fire immediately. Severity is MAJOR from the reviewers who rated it. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 examined the same finding and rejected it, because the suppression is pre-existing, shared by all callers, and retried on each poll tick. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated its own confidence 3.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  confidence=4

There is no ::warning::, no STALL_STATE_WRITE_FAILED log line and no error propagation, so the stall-window-restart guarantee is not delivered on a write failure.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19884-19889 (write_standalone_state_json at 15719-15747, suppression at 15742 and 15745) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The wait-phase branch persists state via write_standalone_state_json, which hides all PATCH/POST failures via `|| true`, then runs `continue` unconditionally.
  WHY: The documented stall-window restart depends on the persisted last_seen_phase=ai:claude-capacity-wait. If the write fails, the old phase and status_since_ts remain, so no reset happens and stall recovery fires immediately on the next eligible tick. The review calls this a new failure mode, because the wait phase was previously skipped and never written.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19884-19889 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Under ERROR PATHS, the same wait-phase branch has no failure handling, logging or degraded-mode behavior when the write fails.
  WHY: The operator gets no signal, and the next tick reads stale state and fires stall recovery with no actionable log line. A fix of 10 lines or fewer would log ::warning:: and STALL_STATE_WRITE_FAILED.
- TASK_GAP:
  Requirement: "Phase 1 of capacity-wait plan ... off by default ... stall recovery leaves the item alone; removing the label restarts its stall window."
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19884-19889 (and the helper at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15719-15747)
  Evidence of absence: The new branch delegates persistence to write_standalone_state_json, whose `|| true` at lines 15742 and 15745 swallows every failure. No ::warning::, no STALL_STATE_WRITE_FAILED log line, no set -e propagation. The restart guarantee is not delivered on a write failure.
  severity=MAJOR | confidence=4

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19884-19888 (write_standalone_state_json at 15740-15745) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The wait path continues without confirming the updated state was persisted, and the writer suppresses failures from both its PATCH and POST calls.
  WHY: If writes keep failing, the stored state keeps its pre-wait phase and timestamp. When the label is removed, the old phase can be treated as stalled and recovery dispatched immediately instead of restarting the window.

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19884-19888 (write_standalone_state_json at 15740-15745) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The capacity-wait path calls write_standalone_state_json, which suppresses API failures with `|| true` at lines 15742 and 15745, so a failed write loses the state update.
  WHY: When the label is removed, the poller reads stale state with the old last_seen_phase and status_since_ts. That can trigger immediate stall recovery and defeats the documented "removing the label restarts the stall window".
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19884-19889 (write_standalone_state_json at 15740-15746) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The ai:claude-capacity-wait branch persists wait-phase state through a helper that swallows every GitHub write failure, so the caller cannot tell whether the write landed.
  WHY: A stale persisted state means the stall window is not reset when the label is removed, so recovery dispatches immediately. The same fail-open contract applies to other write_standalone_state_json call sites in the loop (19918, 19935, 19965, 19973, 19987), so the branch inherits this convention rather than weakening a guard. The suggested fix is to log the failure in this branch only.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
